## Notes

Story engine turns player intent into story beats and world-state changes checked against canon and rules before display (example: Dracula cannot enter uninvited); typed, auditable world model with embeddings; nearly 100 specialized narrative tasks; a tuned 1.7B model beat a 120B general model on one core task. Licensed worlds include Dracula, Oz, Pride and Prejudice, Sherlock Holmes.
